No todos los killis se reproducen de la: Killifish do not all breed the same way. Their life cycle helps explain how to care for their eggs.
Los killis anuales viven en ambientes qu: Annual killifish live in habitats that dry out. Their eggs remain in the soil and may pause their development: this pause is called diapause. When water returns, eggs that are ready may hatch.
En esta selección: rachovii, bellottii y: In this collection: rachovii, bellottii and nigripinnis.
Huevos entre plantas o mopas: Eggs among plants or spawning mops
Algunas especies, como Aphyosemion austr: Some species, such as Aphyosemion australe, lay eggs among plants or in a spawning mop: a bundle of yarn used to collect eggs. These eggs can be incubated in water.
Tres temas para empezar: el origen de lo: Three topics to start with: the origin of your fish, feeding fry and keeping population records.
Guardá el nombre de la especie, el lugar: Keep the species name, place of origin and date. If your fish have a collection code, copy it exactly: it identifies their population of origin.
Los alevines necesitan comida que puedan: Fry need food small enough to swallow. Breeders use infusoria, microworms and newly hatched brine shrimp. The right food depends on the species and the size of the fry.
Los peces de una misma especie pueden te: Fish of the same species may have different colours depending on where they come from. Record the location alongside the name and keep that information when breeding or exchanging fish.
Guardá el origen de tus peces y tus obse: Try a record for your fish’s origin and your observations.
Una población es un grupo de peces del m: A population is a group of fish from the same place of origin. Use a separate record for each one.
